items.label: Validity period
items.value: Valid for 60 days from the purchase date (no extension)

items.label: Where to use
items.value: OLIVE YOUNG stores and the online shop (excluding some stores)

items.label: Cancellation and refund
items.value: Full refund available within the validity period if unused

sections.title: How to use
sections.description:
[OLIVE YOUNG stores]
Present the mobile gift card barcode when paying
(Not available at malls, department stores, KTX stations, and other select in-store locations, or at self-checkout counters)

[OLIVE YOUNG online shop]
Checkout > Check mobile gift card balance > Enter the mobile gift card number > Confirm the balance > Pay

sections.title: Usage information
sections.description:
Support may be unavailable for issues that occur while using a mobile gift card purchased outside official channels, resold, or obtained through improper means
OLIVE YOUNG mobile gift cards can be used immediately at OLIVE YOUNG stores nationwide and in the mobile app. (Including Olive Better) (Excluding some stores; not available on PC)
Multiple mobile gift cards can be used in a single payment in stores, but only one mobile gift card can be used per payment in the online shop.
The card can be used in several installments within the displayed amount.
If your purchase exceeds the mobile gift card amount, you can pay the difference with another payment method.
CJ ONE points can be earned and a cash receipt can be issued at the time of payment.
For inquiries about use or returns, please contact the Gifticon customer center (1800-0133).

sections.title: Changes and cancellation
sections.description: If the voucher has not been used, you can receive a 100% refund within the validity period. Refunds are not available after the validity period has passed or if the voucher has been partially used.

sections.title: Precautions
sections.description:
Once an OLIVE YOUNG mobile gift card expires, it cannot be reused after an exchange or return of the purchased product.
OLIVE YOUNG mobile gift cards cannot be recharged.
OLIVE YOUNG mobile gift cards cannot be used to purchase gift cards, gift certificates, or certain products.
We are not liable for incidents caused by theft, loss, or similar circumstances.
Inquiries received outside customer center hours cannot be processed the same day, and expired cards are handled based on their expired status.
